correctness.rationale: The received ball B(x) contains x, all single deletion-of-0 outputs and all single swaps 01↔10, never an error composition. The compatibility graph on the 2^n words has edge iff balls disjoint, so its maximum clique is precisely the maximum code cardinality. Inspected packaged witnesses in artifacts/optimal_codes.json including 30 length-7 words; independent exhaustive graph construction and coloring branch-and-bound on 128 length-7 vertices established tuple 2,3,4,7,11,17,30, with 102,464 recursive calls; the package verifier has an independently checked coloring pruning lemma and a distinct explicit certificate path (recorded 100221 calls). Exact n=1..7, with no extrapolation.
residual_risks: Either/or one-error asymmetric 0 deletion versus one adjacent transposition; not arbitrary-symbol deletions, not the simultaneous both-error channel, no n≥8 claim.
Finite exhaustive correctness does not imply any values beyond the enumerated n.
